blocks.zh: 簡介與術語表 — 無菌充填的語言基礎
blocks.en: Introduction and Glossary: The Language of Aseptic Filling

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解本指南的目的、範疇，以及為什麼無菌充填 (Aseptic Filling) 比最終滅菌更困難
blocks.en: Understand the purpose and scope of this guide, and why aseptic filling is harder than terminal sterilization

blocks.zh: 掌握指南四大部分的結構，知道每部分的內容重點與應用場景
blocks.en: Grasp the structure of the four parts of the guide, and know the key content and application of each

blocks.zh: 熟悉無菌充填的核心術語：RABS（cRABS/oRABS）、Isolator（Open/Closed）、CIP/SIP、First Air、Fill Curve 等
blocks.en: Become familiar with the core terms of aseptic filling: RABS (cRABS/oRABS), Isolator (Open/Closed), CIP/SIP, First Air, Fill Curve, etc.

blocks.zh: 能夠正確使用縮寫表（AF、APS、CCI、SA、SU、RTU、PUPSIT、VPPF 等）進行專業溝通
blocks.en: Use the abbreviation list (AF, APS, CCI, SA, SU, RTU, PUPSIT, VPPF, etc.) correctly in professional communication

blocks.zh: 建立決策優先序：無菌保證 (SA) > 關鍵品質屬性 (CQA) > 商業需求
blocks.en: Establish the decision hierarchy: Sterility Assurance (SA) > Critical Quality Attributes (CQA) > commercial needs

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為何無菌充填比最終滅菌難？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Is Aseptic Filling Harder Than Terminal Sterilization?

blocks.zh: 無菌保證 (Sterility Assurance, SA) 的實現有兩條路：
blocks.en: There are two routes to Sterility Assurance (SA):

blocks.zh: 最終滅菌 (Terminal Sterilization)：先充填，再整批滅菌。無菌保證在充填之後才建立。相對容錯空間大。
blocks.en: Terminal Sterilization: The product is filled first, then the whole batch is sterilized. Sterility assurance is established after filling, so there is relatively more room for error.

blocks.zh: 無菌充填 (Aseptic Filling)：藥品已事先滅菌，充填時若任何環節污染，無法挽救。無菌保證必須在充填前就已建立，並在整個充填過程中持續維持。
blocks.en: Aseptic Filling: The drug product is sterilized beforehand, and contamination at any step during filling cannot be recovered. Sterility assurance must be established before filling and maintained throughout the entire filling process.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼本指南說：「凡是可以最終滅菌的，就應該最終滅菌」——無菌充填的難度本質上更高。
blocks.en: This is why the guide says that anything that can be terminally sterilized should be terminally sterilized: aseptic filling is inherently more difficult.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：手術室 vs 一般廚房
blocks.en: Analogy: Operating Room vs. Ordinary Kitchen

blocks.zh: 最終滅菌就像先做好食物再用微波爐加熱殺菌，最後一步能消滅前面帶入的污染。
blocks.en: Terminal sterilization is like cooking the food first and then heating it in a microwave to kill germs; the last step eliminates any contamination introduced earlier.

blocks.zh: 無菌充填則像在手術室裡準備食物——所有食材與器具在進入前就已無菌，操作過程中的每一個動作都可能引入污染，而且沒有最後的「殺菌補救」步驟。一旦污染，整批報廢。
blocks.en: Aseptic filling is like preparing food inside an operating room: all ingredients and utensils are already sterile before they enter, every movement during handling can introduce contamination, and there is no final "kill step" to rescue you. Once contaminated, the whole batch is scrapped.

blocks.zh: 結論：無菌充填的每一個設計決策，都必須以「防止任何微生物進入產品」為最高優先。
blocks.en: Conclusion: Every design decision in aseptic filling must give top priority to "preventing any microorganism from entering the product".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：跨職能團隊不是選項，是必須
blocks.en: Key Point: A Cross-Functional Team Is Not Optional, It Is Required

blocks.zh: 本指南特別強調需要跨職能團隊 (Cross-functional team)，包含：工程、操作、品質、微生物學、驗證、產品科學家、包材科學家。
blocks.en: The guide places particular emphasis on a cross-functional team, including engineering, operations, quality, microbiology, validation, product scientists and packaging scientists.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的現實：客戶往往只關注充填速度和成本，但工程師必須在設計階段就把 SA、CQA、彈性（未來產品）全部納入。這份責任不能只落在一個部門。
blocks.en: The CDMO reality: customers often focus only on filling speed and cost, but engineers must build SA, CQA and flexibility (for future products) into the design from the start. This responsibility cannot fall on a single department.

blocks.zh: 決策優先序（每次設計選擇都應回到這個框架）：
blocks.en: Decision hierarchy (return to this framework for every design choice):

blocks.zh: 1. 無菌保證 (Sterility Assurance)
blocks.en: 1. Sterility Assurance

blocks.zh: 2. 關鍵品質屬性 (CQA)
blocks.en: 2. Critical Quality Attributes (CQA)

blocks.zh: 3. 商業與彈性需求
blocks.en: 3. Commercial and flexibility needs

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 的設計靈活性
blocks.en: Practical Application: Design Flexibility for a CDMO

blocks.zh: CDMO 服務多個客戶，每個客戶的產品特性不同（黏度、凍乾需求、充填體積）。因此在設計充填線時，必須額外考慮「未來業務彈性」，例如：是否支援不同容器格式？管路切換時間多長？一次性元件 (SU) 的換型成本？
blocks.en: A CDMO serves multiple customers, and each customer's product has different characteristics (viscosity, lyophilization needs, fill volume). When designing a filling line you must therefore also consider "future business flexibility", for example: Can it support different container formats? How long does a tubing changeover take? What is the changeover cost of single-use (SU) components?

blocks.zh: 本指南提醒：在設計階段就要把這些商業需求「內建」進去，而不是事後改裝——但前提是永遠不能犧牲 SA。
blocks.en: The guide reminds us to "build in" these commercial needs at the design stage rather than retrofit them later, but never at the expense of SA.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Questions to Consider

blocks.zh: 一個可以最終滅菌的注射劑，為什麼製藥公司仍然可能選擇無菌充填？（提示：想想蛋白質藥物的熱穩定性）
blocks.en: Why might a pharmaceutical company still choose aseptic filling for an injectable that could be terminally sterilized? (Hint: think about the heat stability of protein drugs.)

blocks.zh: 在充填系統設計階段，如果 SA 和交期壓力發生衝突，你作為工程師應該如何回應管理層？
blocks.en: During filling system design, if SA conflicts with delivery-time pressure, how should you, as an engineer, respond to management?

blocks.zh: Scope — What This Guide Covers (and What It Does Not) 範疇界定
blocks.en: Scope: What This Guide Covers (and What It Does Not)

blocks.zh: 四大部分結構解析
blocks.en: The Four-Part Structure Explained

blocks.zh: 把這四個部分想成蓋房子的順序：
blocks.en: Think of the four parts as the order of building a house:

blocks.zh: Part 1（技術選擇）：選什麼類型的充填機？蠕動泵還是旋轉活塞泵？先決定大方向。
blocks.en: Part 1 (Technology Selection): What type of filler should you choose? Peristaltic pump or rotary piston pump? Decide the general direction first.

blocks.zh: Part 2（工程考量）：充填線的具體工程細節——管路設計、過濾器、重量檢查、CIP/SIP。
blocks.en: Part 2 (Engineering Considerations): The specific engineering details of the filling line: tubing design, filters, check weighing, CIP/SIP.

blocks.zh: Part 3（操作考量）：實際批次操作中的微生物控制、干預管理、APS 模擬。
blocks.en: Part 3 (Operational Considerations): Microbial control during actual batch operations, intervention management and APS.

blocks.zh: Part 4（粉末充填）：粉末和液體不同，另外討論 Auger Filling、真空粉末充填 (VPPF)。
blocks.en: Part 4 (Powder Filling): Powders differ from liquids and are discussed separately: auger filling and vacuum powder filling (VPPF).

blocks.zh: 這四部分缺一不可——一個成功的充填系統需要同時在技術、工程、操作三個維度都做對，再針對劑型（液體/粉末）調整。
blocks.en: None of the four parts can be omitted. A successful filling system must get technology, engineering and operations all right, and then be adjusted for the dosage form (liquid or powder).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：URS → FRS → SDS 就像房屋建造合約
blocks.en: Analogy: URS → FRS → SDS Is Like a House Construction Contract

blocks.zh: URS（使用者需求規格）= 業主告訴建築師「我要一棟三房兩廳、廚房要有中島、需要停兩部車」——只談需求，不談怎麼做。
blocks.en: URS (User Requirements Specification) = the owner tells the architect, "I want three bedrooms and two living areas, a kitchen with an island, and parking for two cars". It covers requirements only, not how to meet them.

blocks.zh: FRS（功能需求規格）= 建築師回應：「廚房中島將設計為 1.5m×0.8m，有電源插座和排氣管道」——把需求轉化為功能。
blocks.en: FRS (Functional Requirements Specification) = the architect responds, "The kitchen island will be 1.5m×0.8m, with power sockets and an exhaust duct". It translates requirements into functions.

blocks.zh: SDS（系統設計規格）= 施工圖面：「採用 X 品牌花崗岩檯面，厚度 30mm，用 M8 螺絲鎖在特定位置」——具體到材料和尺寸。
blocks.en: SDS (System Design Specification) = the construction drawings: "Use brand X granite countertop, 30mm thick, fixed at specific positions with M8 screws". It goes down to materials and dimensions.

blocks.zh: 充填機採購也是如此：客戶需求 → 設備商回應 → 詳細工程設計 → 驗證 (IQ/OQ/PQ)。
blocks.en: Filling machine procurement works the same way: customer requirements → vendor response → detailed engineering design → qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CCI 不到壓蓋完成不算建立
blocks.en: Key Point: CCI Is Not Established Until Crimping Is Complete

blocks.zh: 這是很多初學者容易忽略的點：一瓶西林瓶，就算已經完全塞好橡皮塞，只要還沒有壓上鋁蓋（crimp seal），容器密封完整性 (CCI) 在法規上尚未建立。
blocks.en: This is a point many beginners overlook: even if a vial is fully stoppered, as long as the aluminum cap has not been crimped on (crimp seal), container closure integrity (CCI) has not yet been established from a regulatory standpoint.

blocks.zh: 實務意義：凍乾產品在冷凍乾燥完成後、出艙前，橡皮塞尚未完全就位——這段時間的操作需要特別謹慎。
blocks.en: Practical significance: for lyophilized products, after freeze-drying is complete and before the chamber is unloaded, the stoppers are not yet fully seated, so operations in this period require particular care.

blocks.zh: 因此本指南的討論範圍延伸到「壓蓋工站」，雖然壓蓋本身不是主要焦點，但必須被納入系統設計中。
blocks.en: For this reason the scope of the guide extends to the "crimping station". Crimping itself is not the main focus, but it must be included in the system design.

blocks.zh: 一個凍乾針劑產品，從充填到最終 CCI 建立，中間經過哪些步驟？哪一步是 SA 最脆弱的環節？
blocks.en: For a lyophilized injectable, what steps lie between filling and final CCI establishment? Which step is the weakest point for SA?

blocks.zh: 為什麼本指南不討論 Blow-Fill-Seal？這兩種技術在 SA 策略上有什麼根本差異？
blocks.en: Why does this guide not discuss Blow-Fill-Seal? What are the fundamental differences in SA strategy between the two technologies?

blocks.zh: 你的公司準備引進一台新充填機，URS 應該由哪個部門主導撰寫？哪些部門必須審閱？
blocks.en: Your company plans to bring in a new filling machine. Which department should lead the writing of the URS, and which departments must review it?

blocks.zh: Glossary (A–G) — Key Terms Defined 術語表（上）
blocks.en: Glossary (A–G): Key Terms Defined

blocks.zh: Biodecontamination（生物去污染）— 深入理解
blocks.en: Biodecontamination: A Closer Look

blocks.zh: 「Biodecontamination」不等於一般清潔或消毒。在無菌充填的語境中，它專指能達到高水準去污染效果的自動化流程，最常見的是 VPHP（汽相過氧化氫），也有使用 Chlorine Dioxide（二氧化氯）或 Peracetic Acid（過乙酸）的系統。
blocks.en: "Biodecontamination" is not the same as general cleaning or disinfection. In aseptic filling it refers specifically to automated processes that achieve a high level of decontamination, most commonly VPHP (vaporized hydrogen peroxide), although some systems use chlorine dioxide or peracetic acid.

blocks.zh: 關鍵區別：
blocks.en: Key distinction:

blocks.zh: 一般消毒（Disinfection）：降低活性微生物，但無法殺滅孢子
blocks.en: Ordinary disinfection: reduces viable microorganisms but cannot kill spores

blocks.zh: Biodecontamination：達到 6-log 孢子殺滅（Sporicidal），通常用於 Isolator 或 cRABS 的循環處理
blocks.en: Biodecontamination: achieves a 6-log sporicidal reduction, and is typically used in cycles for an Isolator or cRABS

blocks.zh: 這是 Isolator 相比 oRABS 的關鍵優勢之一：Isolator 每批次都能執行完整 biodecontamination cycle。
blocks.en: This is one of the key advantages of an Isolator over an oRABS: an Isolator can run a complete biodecontamination cycle for every batch.

blocks.zh: Corrective vs. Inherent Intervention — 干預類型的重要性
blocks.en: Corrective vs. Inherent Intervention: Why the Type of Intervention Matters

blocks.zh: Corrective Intervention（糾正性干預）：非預期的、因設備異常觸發。例：清除堵塞的西林瓶、修補洩漏。這類干預的 SA 風險最高——操作員在非計劃狀態下進入 critical zone。
blocks.en: Corrective Intervention: Unplanned, triggered by an equipment abnormality. Examples: clearing a jammed vial, repairing a leak. This type of intervention carries the highest SA risk, because operators enter the critical zone in an unplanned state.

blocks.zh: Inherent Intervention（固有干預）：程序規定必須執行的干預，如組件補充、環境監測取樣。這些是已知且可事先風險評估的。
blocks.en: Inherent Intervention: An intervention that the procedure requires, such as component replenishment or environmental monitoring sampling. These are known and can be risk assessed in advance.

blocks.zh: 操作重點：兩類干預都必須記錄、評估 SA 影響，並決定是否觸發 APS 失敗判定。Corrective Intervention 一旦頻率上升，通常是設備需要維護的訊號。
blocks.en: Operational focus: Both types of intervention must be recorded, assessed for SA impact, and evaluated to decide whether they trigger an APS failure. A rising frequency of Corrective Interventions is usually a signal that the equipment needs maintenance.

blocks.zh: Fill Curve（充填曲線）— 精準充填的核心
blocks.en: Fill Curve: The Core of Accurate Filling

blocks.zh: Fill Curve 是每支容器充填過程中，充填針運動（stroke）與產品流速、加速度、減速度的時序組合。設計良好的 Fill Curve 需要達到：
blocks.en: The Fill Curve is the timed combination of filling needle movement (stroke) with product flow rate, acceleration and deceleration during the filling of each container. A well-designed Fill Curve must achieve:

blocks.zh: 充填量的精準性（劑量均一）
blocks.en: Accurate fill volume (dose uniformity)

blocks.zh: 液體不濺出、不起泡沫
blocks.en: No splashing of liquid and no foaming

blocks.zh: 充填針進入/退出容器時不污染瓶頸/瓶口
blocks.en: No contamination of the container neck/mouth as the filling needle enters and exits the container

blocks.zh: 高黏度產品的特殊慢速退針（防止拉絲）
blocks.en: A special slow needle withdrawal for high-viscosity products (to prevent stringing)

blocks.zh: Fill Curve 的設定是充填機 IQ/OQ 驗證的重點，也是每次新產品導入時需要重新最佳化的參數。
blocks.en: Setting the Fill Curve is a focus of filling machine IQ/OQ, and it is a parameter that must be re-optimized each time a new product is introduced.

blocks.zh: 比喻：First Air 就像「開刀房的無菌空氣」
blocks.en: Analogy: First Air Is Like "the Sterile Air of an Operating Room"

blocks.zh: 在手術室中，器械護士的無菌托盤必須置於層流空氣 (HEPA filtered laminar flow) 的直接覆蓋下。只要有任何物體（即使是已消毒的東西）橫跨在空氣和托盤之間——這個「已受保護的無菌空間」就被打破了。
blocks.en: In an operating room, the scrub nurse's sterile tray must sit directly under laminar airflow (HEPA filtered laminar flow). If any object (even a disinfected one) passes between the air and the tray, this "protected sterile space" is broken.

blocks.zh: First Air 的概念完全相同：只有從 HEPA 濾網直接吹到產品接觸表面、中間沒有任何障礙物的氣流，才算是 First Air。充填針、操作員的手套、取樣器、傳送帶——任何進入這個空間的物體都會打斷 First Air。
blocks.en: The concept of First Air is exactly the same: only air that flows directly from the HEPA filter onto the product contact surface, with no obstruction in between, counts as First Air. The filling needle, operator gloves, samplers and conveyor belts: any object that enters this space interrupts First Air.

blocks.zh: 設計意涵：RABS/Isolator 的關鍵設計目標之一，就是讓充填針和敞口容器始終處於 First Air 保護下。
blocks.en: Design implication: One of the key design goals of an RABS/Isolator is to keep the filling needle and open containers under First Air protection at all times.

blocks.zh: Grade A Air Supply vs. Classified Grade A — 細微但重要的差異
blocks.en: Grade A Air Supply vs. Classified Grade A: A Subtle but Important Difference

blocks.zh: 兩者的 HEPA 過濾等級相同，但監測要求不同：
blocks.en: The two have the same HEPA filtration grade, but their monitoring requirements differ:

blocks.zh: Classified Grade A：需要持續粒子監測、活性微生物監測，完整 EU GMP Annex 1 分級環境
blocks.en: Classified Grade A: Requires continuous particle monitoring and viable microbial monitoring, and is a fully classified environment under EU GMP Annex 1

blocks.zh: Grade A Air Supply：提供相同質量的氣流，但所在區域本身「未被分級」——用於已完全塞好橡皮塞但尚未壓蓋的西林瓶在輸送過程中的保護
blocks.en: Grade A Air Supply: Provides air of the same quality, but the area itself is "not classified"; it is used to protect fully stoppered but not yet crimped vials during transport

blocks.zh: 這個區別在凍乾出艙後的壓蓋區域特別重要。
blocks.en: This distinction is particularly important in the crimping area after lyophilizer unloading.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Headspace（頂空）的管控與氧化降解
blocks.en: Key Point: Headspace Control and Oxidative Degradation

blocks.zh: 許多生物製劑（mAb、蛋白質藥物）對氧化非常敏感。頂空中的氧氣殘留直接影響產品有效期。常見的頂空保護措施：
blocks.en: Many biologics (mAbs, protein drugs) are highly sensitive to oxidation. Residual oxygen in the headspace directly affects product shelf life. Common headspace protection measures:

blocks.zh: 氮氣覆蓋/吹掃 (N₂ overlaying/sparging)：充填前或充填中以氮氣替換頂空氧氣
blocks.en: Nitrogen overlaying/sparging (N₂ overlaying/sparging): Replace headspace oxygen with nitrogen before or during filling

blocks.zh: 真空加氮氣 (Vacuum + N₂)：凍乾製程本身可部分達到此效果
blocks.en: Vacuum + N₂: The lyophilization process itself can partly achieve this effect

blocks.zh: 充填機必須整合頂空氧氣控制系統，且氮氣純度和供應壓力需要驗證。這是 CQA 的一部分，不是「可選功能」。
blocks.en: The filling machine must integrate a headspace oxygen control system, and nitrogen purity and supply pressure must be validated. This is part of the CQA, not an "optional feature".

blocks.zh: 在你的充填線上，哪些元件屬於 Direct Product Contact Part？哪些屬於 Indirect Product Contact Part？它們分別需要什麼滅菌方式？
blocks.en: On your filling line, which components are Direct Product Contact Parts and which are Indirect Product Contact Parts? What sterilization method does each require?

blocks.zh: 如果一個 Corrective Intervention（清除卡瓶）發生在充填針旁邊10公分處，你如何評估這個干預對批次放行的影響？
blocks.en: If a Corrective Intervention (clearing a jammed vial) takes place 10 cm from the filling needle, how would you assess its impact on batch release?

blocks.zh: Fill Curve 的哪些參數會影響高黏度產品（>50 mPa-s）的充填精度？
blocks.en: Which Fill Curve parameters affect the filling accuracy of high-viscosity products (>50 mPa-s)?

blocks.zh: Glossary (I–S) — Barrier Technologies & Control Terms 術語表（下）：屏障技術核心術語
blocks.en: Glossary (I–S): Barrier Technologies & Control Terms

blocks.zh: 比喻：Isolator = 太空站，RABS = 無塵室加屏障
blocks.en: Analogy: Isolator = Space Station, RABS = Cleanroom with a Barrier

blocks.zh: Isolator（隔離器）= 太空站：太空站與外太空之間有完全密閉的艙壁，每次太空人進出都必須通過氣閘艙（airlock），完全不讓外部環境進入。Isolator 就是這樣——內部環境與外部（cleanroom）完全隔絕，物料進出都經過 RTP（快速傳遞口）或無菌連接，每批前都用 VPHP 做完整 biodecontamination cycle。
blocks.en: Isolator = space station: A space station is separated from outer space by fully sealed walls, and every time an astronaut enters or leaves they must pass through an airlock, so the outside environment never gets in. An Isolator works the same way: its interior is completely separated from the outside (the cleanroom), materials enter and leave through an RTP (rapid transfer port) or sterile connection, and a full VPHP biodecontamination cycle is run before each batch.

blocks.zh: RABS（限制進出屏障系統）= 無塵室裡加了玻璃屏障的操作區：操作員在無塵室中工作，但用玻璃牆和手套箱與產品隔開。門可以（在嚴格條件下）打開。oRABS 的空氣甚至與 cleanroom 共通。
blocks.en: RABS (Restricted Access Barrier System) = an operating area with glass barriers inside a cleanroom: Operators work in the cleanroom but are separated from the product by glass walls and glove ports. The doors can be opened (under strict conditions). The air of an oRABS is even shared with the cleanroom.

blocks.zh: 保護強度：Closed Isolator > Open Isolator > cRABS > oRABS（Active）> oRABS（Passive）
blocks.en: Level of protection: Closed Isolator > Open Isolator > cRABS > oRABS (Active) > oRABS (Passive)

blocks.zh: 比喻：Mousehole 就像醫院手術室的「傳遞窗」
blocks.en: Analogy: A Mousehole Is Like the Operating Room "Pass-Through Window"

blocks.zh: 手術室裡有一種「傳遞窗 (Pass-through window)」——器械護士從清潔區傳遞物品進手術室，但兩邊的門不能同時開。這設計的目的是維持差壓和防止空氣亂流。
blocks.en: Operating rooms have a "pass-through window": the scrub nurse passes items from the clean area into the operating room, but the doors on both sides cannot be open at the same time. The purpose of this design is to maintain differential pressure and prevent air turbulence.

blocks.zh: Mousehole 的道理相同：讓西林瓶或注射器巢盤通過屏障進入下一區，但尺寸要盡量小，以維持兩區之間的差壓（通常 critical zone 正壓）和單向氣流，防止外部粒子被捲入。
blocks.en: A mousehole works on the same principle: it lets vials or syringe nests pass through the barrier into the next zone, but it should be as small as possible to maintain the differential pressure between the two zones (usually positive pressure in the critical zone) and unidirectional airflow, and to prevent external particles from being drawn in.

blocks.zh: Intrinsic Sterile Connection Device — 無菌連接的兩大技術
blocks.en: Intrinsic Sterile Connection Device: Two Major Technologies for Sterile Connection

blocks.zh: 在 Isolator 系統中，液體管路的無菌連接是關鍵風險點。兩種主流方式：
blocks.en: In an Isolator system, the sterile connection of liquid tubing is a key risk point. There are two mainstream approaches:

blocks.zh: 機械式無菌連接器（Aseptic Connectors）：如 Colder Products (CPC) 或 Pall SciLog 等品牌，連接頭兩端有膜片保護，扣合時才去除膜片，形成無菌至無菌的密封。適合一次性系統 (SUS)。
blocks.en: Mechanical sterile connectors (Aseptic Connectors): Brands such as Colder Products (CPC) or Pall SciLog. The two ends of the connector are protected by membranes that are removed only when the connector is mated, forming a sterile-to-sterile seal. Suitable for single-use systems (SUS).

blocks.zh: 無菌管路熔接（Sterile Tube Welding）：如 Terumo TSCD® 或 GE ReadyMate™，用高溫融合方式將兩段管路接合，完全無縫接口，完整性更高。常用於生物反應器到充填機的產品管路。
blocks.en: Sterile Tube Welding: Such as Terumo TSCD® or GE ReadyMate™, which join two lengths of tubing by high-temperature fusion, giving a completely seamless joint and higher integrity. Commonly used for product tubing from the bioreactor to the filling machine.

blocks.zh: 兩種方式都需要操作員培訓和程序驗證，且每次連接都應記錄以支持批次可追溯性。
blocks.en: Both methods require operator training and procedure validation, and every connection should be recorded to support batch traceability.

blocks.zh: Servo Motor + Shift Register — 充填機的「大腦和神經系統」
blocks.en: Servo Motor + Shift Register: The "Brain and Nervous System" of the Filling Machine

blocks.zh: Servo Motor（伺服馬達）：充填機的精準動作來自伺服馬達，它可以精確控制充填針的位置、速度、加減速（即 Fill Curve 的執行）。相比傳統凸輪驅動，伺服馬達可以通過軟體調整 Fill Curve，無需更換機械零件。
blocks.en: Servo Motor: The precise motion of the filling machine comes from servo motors, which accurately control the position, speed and acceleration/deceleration of the filling needle (that is, the execution of the Fill Curve). Compared with a traditional cam drive, a servo motor allows the Fill Curve to be adjusted through software without replacing mechanical parts.

blocks.zh: Shift Register（移位暫存器）：PLC 程式中用來追蹤「哪一個容器需要被剔除」的機制。想像充填線上有1000個西林瓶在移動，第50個在重量檢查站被判定為不合格——但剔除站在傳送帶的下游，距離15個位置。Shift Register 就像一串「帶標記的貨物位置記錄」，確保第50個瓶子到達剔除站時被正確剔除，而不是誤剔第51個。
blocks.en: Shift Register: The mechanism in PLC programs used to track "which container needs to be rejected". Imagine 1,000 vials moving along the filling line, where the 50th is judged out of specification at the check weigher, but the reject station is downstream on the conveyor, 15 positions away. The Shift Register is like a series of "tagged position records", ensuring that the 50th vial is correctly rejected when it reaches the reject station, rather than the 51st being rejected by mistake.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：oRABS 的 biodecontamination 是特例，不是常規
blocks.en: Key Point: Biodecontamination of an oRABS Is a Special Case, Not the Norm

blocks.zh: 指南特別說明：某些設施會對整個 cleanroom（包含其中的 oRABS）進行 biodecontamination——但這是特殊案例，不代表 oRABS 本身具有 biodecontamination 能力。
blocks.en: The guide specifically notes that some facilities biodecontaminate the entire cleanroom (including the oRABS within it), but this is a special case and does not mean the oRABS itself has biodecontamination capability.

blocks.zh: 法規觀點：如果你的 oRABS 設施聲稱進行了 biodecontamination，監管機構會深入查問驗證文件、循環參數、生物指示劑位置。不能只是「用 VPHP 機器在 cleanroom 裡跑一圈」就聲稱達到 biodecontamination。
blocks.en: Regulatory view: if your oRABS facility claims to perform biodecontamination, regulators will probe the validation documents, cycle parameters and biological indicator locations. You cannot claim biodecontamination simply by "running a VPHP machine around the cleanroom".

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 選擇屏障技術的決策框架
blocks.en: Practical Application: A CDMO Decision Framework for Choosing Barrier Technology

blocks.zh: CDMO 在評估要用 Isolator 還是 RABS 時，通常需要平衡以下因素：
blocks.en: When a CDMO evaluates whether to use an Isolator or RABS, it usually needs to balance the following factors:

blocks.zh: SA 要求：客戶的藥品是否高風險（例如生物製劑、凍乾、高活性）？SA 要求越高，傾向 Isolator
blocks.en: SA requirements: Is the customer's product high risk (for example a biologic, lyophilized or highly potent product)? The higher the SA requirement, the more the choice leans toward an Isolator

blocks.zh: 換型時間 (Changeover)：Isolator 的 biodecontamination cycle 通常需要 2–4 小時；oRABS 換型較快。CDMO 如果批次小、產品多樣，TCO 計算需考慮這個時間損耗
blocks.en: Changeover time: An Isolator biodecontamination cycle usually takes 2–4 hours, while oRABS changeover is faster. For a CDMO with small batches and many different products, the TCO calculation must account for this time loss

blocks.zh: 高活性藥物 (HPAPI)：cRABS 或 Isolator 都能提供操作員保護，但需要整合洩漏偵測和負壓設計
blocks.en: Highly potent APIs (HPAPI): Both cRABS and Isolators can provide operator protection, but leak detection and negative pressure design must be integrated

blocks.zh: 法規趨勢：EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 明確優先推薦 Isolator。選擇 RABS 需要提供 CCS 文件支持
blocks.en: Regulatory trend: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) clearly gives preference to Isolators. Choosing RABS requires documentation in the CCS to support it

blocks.zh: 一個 Open Isolator 和一個 Closed RABS，哪個 SA 保護等級更高？各自的主要弱點是什麼？
blocks.en: Between an Open Isolator and a Closed RABS, which offers a higher level of SA protection? What are the main weaknesses of each?

blocks.zh: 如果充填線的 Shift Register 邏輯出現 bug，可能導致什麼品質問題？如何在 OQ 驗證中測試 Shift Register 功能？
blocks.en: If the Shift Register logic of a filling line has a bug, what quality problems could result? How would you test Shift Register function during OQ?

blocks.zh: Mousehole 的尺寸如果設計過大，會帶來什麼 SA 風險？
blocks.en: If a mousehole is designed too large, what SA risks does it bring?

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 客戶希望用最低成本引進充填能力，建議選 oRABS Passive 還是 Active？理由是什麼？
blocks.en: A CDMO customer wants to bring in filling capability at the lowest cost. Would you recommend a Passive or an Active oRABS, and why?

blocks.zh: 三層產品接觸分類：直接、間接、非接觸
blocks.en: Three Levels of Product Contact: Direct, Indirect, Non-Contact

blocks.zh: 正確分類零件的接觸層級，直接決定滅菌/消毒策略：
blocks.en: Classifying parts correctly by contact level directly determines the sterilization/disinfection strategy:

blocks.zh: CDMO 常見錯誤：將 Indirect Contact Part 只做表面消毒而非滅菌，或未能清楚定義各零件的分類——這在法規審查時是高頻缺陷。
blocks.en: Common CDMO mistake: Applying only surface disinfection rather than sterilization to Indirect Contact Parts, or failing to define the classification of each part clearly. This is a frequent deficiency in regulatory inspections.

blocks.zh: cRABS vs oRABS — 快速對照表
blocks.en: cRABS vs. oRABS: Quick Comparison Table

blocks.zh: 注意：cRABS 雖然叫「Closed」，但相比 Closed Isolator 仍屬「Open System」——因為有 Mousehole 讓容器進出，沒有完全密封的 biodecontamination。
blocks.en: Note: Although a cRABS is called "Closed", it is still an "Open System" compared with a Closed Isolator, because the mousehole lets containers in and out and there is no fully sealed biodecontamination.

blocks.zh: Abbreviations — Complete Reference Table 縮寫完整參考表
blocks.en: Abbreviations: Complete Reference Table

blocks.zh: 縮寫分組記憶法：按功能分類
blocks.en: Memorizing Abbreviations by Function

blocks.zh: 34個縮寫不需要死記，按功能分組理解效果更好：
blocks.en: You do not need to memorize the 34 abbreviations by rote; grouping them by function works better:

blocks.zh: 屏障技術類（Barrier Technologies）：
blocks.en: Barrier Technologies:

blocks.zh: RABS — 限制進出屏障系統（總稱）
blocks.en: RABS: Restricted Access Barrier System (general term)

blocks.zh: cRABS — 封閉式 RABS（有獨立排氣）
blocks.en: cRABS: Closed RABS (with its own separate exhaust)

blocks.zh: oRABS — 開放式 RABS（與室內空氣交換）
blocks.en: oRABS: Open RABS (exchanges air with the room)

blocks.zh: 無菌品質保證類（Sterility & Quality Assurance）：
blocks.en: Sterility & Quality Assurance:

blocks.zh: SA — 無菌保證（最高優先）
blocks.en: SA: Sterility Assurance (highest priority)

blocks.zh: APS — 無菌製程模擬（培養基模擬灌裝）
blocks.en: APS: Aseptic Process Simulation (media fill)

blocks.zh: CCI — 容器密封完整性
blocks.en: CCI: Container Closure Integrity

blocks.zh: IPC — 製程中管控（重量、體積）
blocks.en: IPC: In-Process Control (weight, volume)

blocks.zh: AVS — 氣流視覺化研究
blocks.en: AVS: Airflow Visualization Study

blocks.zh: 充填機技術類（Filling Technologies）：
blocks.en: Filling Technologies:

blocks.zh: PP — 蠕動泵 (Peristaltic Pump)
blocks.en: PP: Peristaltic Pump

blocks.zh: RPP — 旋轉活塞泵 (Rotary Piston Pump)
blocks.en: RPP: Rotary Piston Pump

blocks.zh: TP — 時間壓力充填 (Time Pressure)
blocks.en: TP: Time Pressure filling

blocks.zh: DP — 膜片泵 (Diaphragm Pump)
blocks.en: DP: Diaphragm Pump

blocks.zh: AF — 螺旋充填（粉末用，Auger Filling）
blocks.en: AF: Auger Filling (for powders)

blocks.zh: VPPF — 真空壓力粉末充填
blocks.en: VPPF: Vacuum Pressure Powder Filling

blocks.zh: 設備/材料類：
blocks.en: Equipment/Materials:

blocks.zh: CIP — 就地清洗（類比洗碗機）
blocks.en: CIP: Clean-in-Place (analogous to a dishwasher)

blocks.zh: SIP — 就地滅菌（類比高壓滅菌）
blocks.en: SIP: Sterilize-in-Place (analogous to an autoclave)

blocks.zh: SU / SUS — 一次性使用 / 一次性系統
blocks.en: SU / SUS: Single-Use / Single-Use System

blocks.zh: RTU — 即用型（預滅菌容器）
blocks.en: RTU: Ready-to-Use (presterilized containers)

blocks.zh: RTS — 待滅菌型
blocks.en: RTS: Ready-to-Sterilize

blocks.zh: RTP — 快速傳遞口（用於 Isolator/RABS 物料進出）
blocks.en: RTP: Rapid Transfer Port (for material transfer into and out of an Isolator/RABS)

blocks.zh: COC — 環烯烴共聚物（透明玻璃替代材料）
blocks.en: COC: Cyclic Olefin Copolymer (a transparent glass-substitute material)

blocks.zh: HEPA — 高效過濾空氣濾膜
blocks.en: HEPA: High-Efficiency Particulate Air filter

blocks.zh: PLC — 可程式邏輯控制器
blocks.en: PLC: Programmable Logic Controller

blocks.zh: OEM — 原始設備製造商
blocks.en: OEM: Original Equipment Manufacturer

blocks.zh: 產品容量類：
blocks.en: Product Volume:

blocks.zh: SVP — 小容量注射劑（<100 mL）
blocks.en: SVP: Small-Volume Parenteral (<100 mL)

blocks.zh: LVP — 大容量注射劑（≥100 mL）
blocks.en: LVP: Large-Volume Parenteral (≥100 mL)

blocks.zh: 工程/財務類：
blocks.en: Engineering/Financial:

blocks.zh: LSU — 換線設定
blocks.en: LSU: Line Set-Up (changeover setup)

blocks.zh: TCO — 總擁有成本
blocks.en: TCO: Total Cost of Ownership

blocks.zh: ID/OD — 內徑/外徑（管路規格）
blocks.en: ID/OD: Inner Diameter/Outer Diameter (tubing specification)

blocks.zh: RPM — 每分鐘轉速
blocks.en: RPM: Revolutions Per Minute

blocks.zh: mPa-s — 毫帕斯卡秒（黏度單位）
blocks.en: mPa-s: millipascal-second (unit of viscosity)

blocks.zh: SOP — 標準作業程序
blocks.en: SOP: Standard Operating Procedure

blocks.zh: 比喻：CIP/SIP — 洗碗機 + 高壓滅菌鍋
blocks.en: Analogy: CIP/SIP, a Dishwasher + an Autoclave

blocks.zh: CIP（就地清洗）：就像洗碗機——不需要把餐具拆下來搬到廚房外，直接在原地用熱水和清洗劑自動沖洗循環。充填機的液體管路在批次結束後，用清洗液（通常是 WFI、NaOH、酸）循環沖洗，再取樣確認殘留合格。
blocks.en: CIP (Clean-in-Place): Like a dishwasher: you do not have to dismantle the tableware and carry it out of the kitchen; hot water and detergent are circulated automatically right where it is. After a batch, the liquid path of the filling machine is flushed by circulating cleaning solutions (usually WFI, NaOH, acid), and samples are then taken to confirm that residues are acceptable.

blocks.zh: SIP（就地滅菌）：就像高壓滅菌鍋（Autoclave）的升級版——不需要把零件拆下來放進高壓鍋，直接用蒸氣在管路和設備原位循環加熱達到滅菌標準（通常 121°C, F₀≥15 min）。完成後管路保持無菌狀態直到充填開始。
blocks.en: SIP (Sterilize-in-Place): Like an upgraded autoclave: you do not have to remove parts and put them into an autoclave; steam is circulated and heated in the tubing and equipment in place to reach the sterilization standard (usually 121°C, F₀≥15 min). After completion the tubing stays sterile until filling begins.

blocks.zh: 組合拳：充填前的標準流程通常是「CIP → SIP → 完整性測試（濾膜/管路） → 充填」。CIP 負責清潔，SIP 負責無菌，兩者缺一不可。
blocks.en: The combination: The standard pre-filling sequence is usually "CIP → SIP → integrity test (filter/tubing) → filling". CIP provides cleanliness and SIP provides sterility; neither can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 比喻：SU（一次性使用）— 免洗餐具 vs 瓷器
blocks.en: Analogy: SU (Single-Use), Disposable Tableware vs. Porcelain

blocks.zh: SU 系統（Single-Use System）= 免洗餐具：每次使用全新的一次性管路、泵頭、容器，用完即丟。不需要 CIP/SIP 驗證，換型快，適合多品種小批量。缺點：塑膠耗材成本高，可浸出物 (Leachables/Extractables) 需要評估，供應鏈風險。
blocks.en: SU system (Single-Use System) = disposable tableware: Brand-new disposable tubing, pump heads and containers are used each time and discarded afterwards. No CIP/SIP validation is needed, changeover is fast, and it suits many products in small batches. Drawbacks: high cost of plastic consumables, leachables/extractables must be assessed, and there is supply chain risk.

blocks.zh: 傳統不鏽鋼系統 = 瓷器：耐用、可重複使用，但需要完整的 CIP/SIP 清潔驗證，換型慢，清潔驗證成本高。適合大批量、少品種。
blocks.en: Traditional stainless steel system = porcelain: Durable and reusable, but requires full CIP/SIP cleaning validation, has slow changeover and high cleaning validation cost. Suitable for large batches of few products.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的抉擇：今日 CDMO 趨勢明顯轉向 SU，尤其是臨床批次和生物製劑。RTU（Ready-to-Use，預滅菌即用型容器）是 SU 概念延伸到初級包材的版本——免洗免滅菌的預充玻璃注射器或西林瓶，直接上線充填。
blocks.en: The CDMO choice: Today the CDMO trend is clearly toward SU, especially for clinical batches and biologics. RTU (Ready-to-Use, presterilized containers) extends the SU concept to primary packaging: pre-washed, presterilized prefilled glass syringes or vials go straight onto the line for filling.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：COC/COP — 不是 Clean-Out-of-Place！
blocks.en: Key Point: COC/COP Is Not Clean-Out-of-Place!

blocks.zh: 這是一個容易產生混淆的縮寫陷阱。COC 在本指南中代表「Cyclic Olefin Copolymer（環烯烴共聚物）」，一種用於製造透明玻璃替代型西林瓶和預充針筒的熱塑性材料，特點是：
blocks.en: This abbreviation is a common source of confusion. In this guide COC stands for "Cyclic Olefin Copolymer", a thermoplastic used to make transparent glass-substitute vials and prefilled syringes, with these characteristics:

blocks.zh: 高透明度（媲美玻璃）
blocks.en: High transparency (comparable to glass)

blocks.zh: 低溶出物（比普通塑膠更適合注射劑）
blocks.en: Low extractables (better suited to injectables than ordinary plastics)

blocks.zh: 耐 EO 滅菌和放射線滅菌，但不耐高壓蒸氣
blocks.en: Resistant to EO and radiation sterilization, but not to autoclave steam

blocks.zh: 輕量、不易碎（適合機器人自動化充填線）
blocks.en: Lightweight and not easily broken (suitable for robotic automated filling lines)

blocks.zh: 注意：在設備清潔語境中，「COP」代表 Clean-Out-of-Place（拆出清洗），是與 CIP 相對的概念。本指南為避免混淆，全程使用 COC 代表環烯烴材料家族。
blocks.en: Note: In the equipment cleaning context, "COP" stands for Clean-Out-of-Place, the counterpart of CIP. To avoid confusion, this guide uses COC throughout for the cyclic olefin material family.

blocks.zh: TCO 概念計算：一次性 vs 傳統系統的 5 年總成本
blocks.en: TCO Concept Calculation: 5-Year Total Cost of Single-Use vs. Traditional Systems

blocks.zh:
傳統不鏽鋼系統（5年 TCO 概算）：
  設備採購：         $X（較高初期投資）
  CIP/SIP 驗證：     $Y（清潔驗證、殘留測試、再驗證）
  清潔耗材（5年）：  $Z（WFI、清洗劑、耗用品）
  停機換型時間成本：  小時數 × 產能損失
  ─────────────────────────────
  5年傳統系統 TCO = X + Y + Z + 停機成本

一次性系統（5年 TCO 概算）：
  設備採購：         $X'（較低，通常40-60%傳統成本）
  SU 耗材（5年）：   $Z'（批次 × 每套耗材成本，通常較高）
  E&L 研究：         $E（可浸出物/溶出物評估，一次性成本）
  供應鏈冗餘儲備：   $S（供應商風險緩衝）
  ─────────────────────────────
  5年 SU 系統 TCO = X' + Z' + E + S

TCO 分析的核心結論：
→ 批量小、品種多 → SU 通常 TCO 更低
→ 批量大、品種少 → 傳統系統通常 TCO 更低
→ 臨床階段 → SU 靈活性優先
→ 商業量產 → 需要詳細計算後再決定
blocks.en:
Traditional stainless steel system (5-year TCO estimate):
  Equipment purchase:          $X (higher initial investment)
  CIP/SIP validation:          $Y (cleaning validation, residue testing, revalidation)
  Cleaning consumables (5 yr): $Z (WFI, detergents, supplies)
  Downtime/changeover cost:    hours × lost capacity
  ─────────────────────────────
  5-year traditional TCO = X + Y + Z + downtime cost

Single-use system (5-year TCO estimate):
  Equipment purchase:          $X' (lower, usually 40-60% of traditional cost)
  SU consumables (5 yr):       $Z' (batches × cost per set, usually higher)
  E&L studies:                 $E (leachables/extractables assessment, one-time cost)
  Supply chain redundancy:     $S (supplier risk buffer)
  ─────────────────────────────
  5-year SU TCO = X' + Z' + E + S

Key conclusions of the TCO analysis:
→ Small batches, many products → SU usually has lower TCO
→ Large batches, few products → traditional systems usually have lower TCO
→ Clinical stage → SU flexibility takes priority
→ Commercial production → decide only after detailed calculation

blocks.zh: 一個新客戶帶來一個 mAb 凍乾製劑項目，你需要評估用 RTU 西林瓶 + SU 管路 vs 傳統 RTS 玻璃瓶 + 不鏽鋼管路。請列出你會收集的5個關鍵數據點。
blocks.en: A new customer brings a lyophilized mAb project, and you need to evaluate RTU vials + SU tubing against traditional RTS glass vials + stainless steel tubing. List the 5 key data points you would collect.

blocks.zh: AVS（氣流視覺化研究）的目的是什麼？在 RABS 中哪個位置最需要做 AVS？
blocks.en: What is the purpose of an AVS (Airflow Visualization Study)? Where in an RABS is an AVS most needed?

blocks.zh: 一個充填機的 IPC（製程中管控）系統，用 100% 線上重量檢查 vs 統計抽樣重量檢查，對 SA 和批次放行各有什麼影響？
blocks.en: For the IPC (in-process control) system of a filling machine, what are the respective effects on SA and batch release of 100% online check weighing versus statistical sampling check weighing?

blocks.en: What advantages and potential risks does COC material bring in filling operations? When evaluating RTU COC vials, which documents would you ask the supplier to provide?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 無菌充填的根本挑戰：SA 必須在充填前建立並在整個過程中維持，沒有最終滅菌的「補救」機會——這是所有設計決策的出發點。
blocks.en: The fundamental challenge of aseptic filling: SA must be established before filling and maintained throughout the process, with no terminal sterilization "rescue" opportunity. This is the starting point for every design decision.

blocks.zh: 指南四大部分：Part 1（技術選擇）→ Part 2（工程考量）→ Part 3（操作管控）→ Part 4（粉末充填），每部分互相關聯，缺一不可。
blocks.en: The four parts of the guide: Part 1 (Technology Selection) → Part 2 (Engineering Considerations) → Part 3 (Operational Control) → Part 4 (Powder Filling). The parts are interrelated and none can be omitted.

blocks.zh: 屏障技術光譜：Closed Isolator（最高保護）→ Open Isolator → cRABS → oRABS Active → oRABS Passive（最低保護）；選擇應基於 SA 需求、產品特性和 TCO 分析。
blocks.en: The barrier technology spectrum: Closed Isolator (highest protection) → Open Isolator → cRABS → oRABS Active → oRABS Passive (lowest protection). The choice should be based on SA needs, product characteristics and TCO analysis.

blocks.zh: 一次性系統（SU）vs 傳統系統：SU = 免洗餐具（快速換型、無 CIP/SIP 驗證需求）；傳統 = 瓷器（耐用但驗證複雜）；選擇取決於批量大小和產品多樣性。
blocks.en: Single-use systems (SU) vs. traditional systems: SU = disposable tableware (fast changeover, no CIP/SIP validation needed); traditional = porcelain (durable but complex to validate). The choice depends on batch size and product variety.

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語操作理解：First Air（未被打斷的 HEPA 直接氣流）、Fill Curve（充填針運動時序）、Biodecontamination（孢子級別消毒）、Shift Register（PLC 追蹤剔除邏輯）——每個術語背後都有工程意涵。
blocks.en: Key terms in operational terms: First Air (uninterrupted direct HEPA airflow), Fill Curve (timing of filling needle movement), Biodecontamination (sporicidal-level decontamination), Shift Register (PLC reject tracking logic). Behind every term lies an engineering implication.

blocks.zh: 決策優先序永遠是：無菌保證 (SA) > 關鍵品質屬性 (CQA) > 商業與彈性需求。
blocks.en: The decision hierarchy is always: Sterility Assurance (SA) > Critical Quality Attributes (CQA) > commercial and flexibility needs.

blocks.zh: 縮寫速記：34個縮寫按「屏障技術、無菌品質、充填機類型、設備/材料、產品規格、工程財務」六大類分組記憶。
blocks.en: Abbreviation shortcut: The 34 abbreviations are memorized in six groups: barrier technology, sterility and quality, filler type, equipment/materials, product specification, and engineering/financial.
